title: Semantic CI guard rejects the cluster tests in test:semantic
description: develop CI 'Semantic ground contracts' has failed since 2026-10-10: analysis/tests/test_semantic_ci.py requires test:semantic to list exactly web/test/semantic-*.test.ts plus amplify/semantic/*.test.ts, but develop added test/audio-clusters.test.ts and test/cluster-curator.test.ts. The semantic-ground job already runs the cluster Python tests, so the guard should accept the cluster TS tests too.
